newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR THE EUROPEAN CUP WINNERS' CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR THE EUROPEAN CUP WINNERS' CUP FINAL.

text.p: Barcelona coach Bobby Robson recalled Romanian international Gheorghe Popescu to his starting line-up and named him as captain to face Paris St Germain in the European Cup Winners' Cup final on Wednesday.

Popescu plays in a side rejigged because of injuries to Brazilian Giovanni and Frenchman Laurent Blanc. Giovanni at least had the consolation of a place on the substitutes' bench after coming through a light fitness test on the pitch two hours before kick-off.
Fernando Couto comes into the back four while Popescu will play in his favoured position of right midfield.
There were no surprises in the Paris St Germain line-up which included seven of the players who won this trophy last season, including scorer Bruno N'Gotty.

PSG were attempting to become the first club in the competition's 36-year history to win it in successive seasons, while Barcelona were looking for an unprecedented fourth victory after wins in 1979, 1982 and 1989.

If the scores were level at the end of 90 minutes, the match could be decided by a golden goal -- the first goal scored in extra time. If there were no goals in extra time, the outcome would be decided on penalties.
Barcelona: 1-Vitor Baia; 12-Sergi, 26-Fernando Couto, 3- Abelardo, 2-Ferrer, 4-Josep Guardiola, 5-Gheorghe Popescu, 7- Luis Figo, 23-Ivan de la Pena, 21-Luis Enrique, 9-Ronaldo.
Paris St Germain: 1-Bernard Lama; 22-Didier Domi, 13-Lauren Fournier, 4-Bruno N'Gotty, 6-Paul Le Guen, 19-Jerome Leroy, 15- Benoit Cauet, 8-Vincent Guerin, 7-Leonardo, 10-Rai, 11-Patrice Loko.
